name: Example Removals
summary: Example Removals is a family-run removals company in Bexhill-on-Sea. We move homes and offices across Sussex and Kent, with packing, storage and house clearance. Fully insured, BAR members since 1998.

services.name: House removals
services.description: Full and part loads across Sussex, Kent and the UK.

services.name: Storage
services.description: Clean, secure containerised storage, by the week.

faqs.q: How far ahead should I book?
faqs.a: Four to six weeks is ideal, but we can often move you sooner.
Yes. We deliver boxes and packing materials free before your move.
